passive.name: Tailwind
passive.description: Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her. Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

spells.name: Howling Gale
spells.description: Janna summons a tornado that grows stronger over seconds then blows along its path. It deals - magic damage and Knocks Up for - seconds. The distance, damage, and Knock Up duration increase based on how much the tornado grew. Janna can Recast to send the tornado early.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MinimumDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Zephyr
spells.description: Passive: Janna gains Move Speed and is Ghosted. Active: Janna's elemental strikes an enemy, Slowing them by for seconds, and dealing + magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Eye Of The Storm
spells.description: Janna grants an ally champion or turret Shield for seconds. While shielded, they gain Attack Damage. Janna refunds % of the cooldown whenever she impairs an enemy champion's movement with an Ability.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Monsoon
spells.description: Janna summons a magical monsoon, Knocking Back nearby enemies then healing nearby allies for Health over seconds. Moving or using an Ability ends the monsoon early.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.
